note: Used both for respectful greeting and gratitude.
SOV Breakdown: Ne (Subject: I) + an (Object: rice) + cho (Verb: eat).

assamese: মই গাহৰি মাংস ৰান্ধি আছো (Moi gahori mangxo randhi aso)
note: SOV Breakdown: Ne (I) + phak-ok (pork meat) + thok-lo (am cooking).

assamese: বলক চাহ খাবলৈ যাওঁ (Bolok sah khaboloi jaon)
note: SOV Hortative: Sangho (tea) + jun-ik-nang (let's drink together).
SOV Interrogative: Nang hem (your home) + kopi-si (where is).

english: I am going to the market
assamese: মই বজাৰলৈ গৈ আছো (Moi bojaroloi goi aso)
note: SOV Motion: Ne (I) + bazar (market) + dam-lo (am going).

assamese: মই ঘৰলৈ গৈ আছো (Moi ghoroloi goi aso)
note: SOV Motion: Ne (I) + hem (home) + dam-lo (am going).
SOV Interrogative: Nang men (your name) + kopi-ma (what).
SOV Statement: Ne men (my name) + Bikash.
Literally 'Are you well/good?' (mesen = good/well, -ma = question marker).
